classification: nondimensional classical mixed-gradient-flow surrogate; not a fundamental action
scope_exclusions: MFE, fundamental matter, geometry, general covariance, Liouville, CFT, BCJ, consciousness, quantum advantage, and real-world matter claims

free_energy.F_CP10: integral[(kappa_psi/2)|grad psi|^2 +(m_psi^2/2)(psi-psi_bar)^2 +(kappa_Phi/2)|grad Phi|^2 +(lambda_Phi/4)(Phi^2-v_Phi^2)^2 - eta Phi^2 psi] dx

variational_derivatives_and_flow.mu_Phi: -kappa_Phi Delta Phi + lambda_Phi Phi(Phi^2-v_Phi^2) - 2 eta Phi psi
variational_derivatives_and_flow.independent_check: Differentiate each local term pointwise and integrate the gradient terms by parts under periodic boundaries. A finite-difference directional-derivative audit is mandatory before a run.
variational_derivatives_and_flow.continuous_identity: dF_CP10/dt = -M_psi integral |grad mu_psi|^2 dx - M_Phi integral mu_Phi^2 dx <= 0
variational_derivatives_and_flow.boundary_of_claim: This is a continuous classical identity only; no exact discrete monotonicity is claimed without an integrator-specific proof.

transform_convention.dtype: float64 real fields; complex128 Fourier coefficients and reductions
transform_convention.integral: integral f dx is approximated by dx^2 sum_(j,l)f[j,l]
transform_convention.hermitian: fhat[-p mod N,-q mod N]=conjugate(fhat[p,q]); self-conjugate modes (p,q) in {0,N/2}x{0,N/2} are real.

startup_audits.name: convergence_oracle
startup_audits.threshold: manufactured solution or independently solved reference with predeclared norms and measured refinement

dealiasing.rule: Apply the rectangular 2/3 mask to nonlinear products: retain only |kx|<=N/3 AND |ky|<=N/3.

diagnostics.prefilter_removed_fraction: energy removed from each nonlinear product by the mask divided by that product's prefilter energy; threshold <=0.10 as a hard resolution diagnostic
diagnostics.near_cutoff_resolved_fraction: resolved-state spectral energy in 0.8(N/3)<=max(|kx|,|ky|)<=N/3 divided by total resolved-state energy; threshold <=0.02 as a hard resolution diagnostic

dealiasing.justification: The first detects nonlinear content discarded before aliasing; the second measures resolved energy near the retained cutoff. Neither is a post-filter zero band.
dealiasing.failure_interpretation: resolution/aliasing insufficient; do not interpret an effect as physical.

paired_initial_conditions.construction: Use a counter-based Philox4x32-10 generator. For base seed s, field tag psi=0 and Phi=1, Fourier mode (p,q), and component c define counter=(s,field_tag,p*N+q,c); map two uint32 outputs to independent standard normals by fixed Box-Muller. Generate only independent half-plane modes, set conjugates exactly, and make self-conjugate coefficients real.
paired_initial_conditions.psi: Apply the frozen baseline spectral initializer to its coefficients once per seed.
paired_initial_conditions.Phi: Apply a fixed |k|<=4 band-limit, zero mean, then scale to physical-space standard deviation 0.05.
paired_initial_conditions.pairing: Hash psi_0 and Phi_0 arrays before each stage. Every arm for that seed derives from these same continuum coefficients. At N=32/64/128, retain the same physical Fourier coefficients within the available common band and zero-pad new modes; never redraw pixels.
paired_initial_conditions.hashes: Record SHA-256 of canonical C-order float64 arrays plus shape, dtype, transform convention, and generator manifest hash.

null_controls: one_way: Phi sees psi through -eta Phi^2 psi, while psi evolves exactly as eta=0
phase_permuted_psi: deterministic nonzero-mode phase permutation preserving Hermitian symmetry, amplitudes, and zero mode
label_permutation: deterministic cyclic pairing of Phi realizations to psi realizations across a complete seed block; report only if all pairings are defined
conditions.mechanistic_sensitivity: sign-reversed +eta Phi^2 psi at eta=0.1; not a null control and never fails the gate merely for differing from zero.

seeds.estimand: ensemble of random initial-condition realizations, not physical experimental subjects

trajectory_endpoints.cadence: record every 0.05 physical-time units, including t=0 and T=10; no cadence change after execution begins
trajectory_endpoints.quadrature: For field a, ||a||_trajectory^2 = sum_r w_r dx^2 sum_(j,l)|a(t_r,x_j,y_l)|^2, with trapezoid weights w_0=w_R=0.025 and interior w_r=0.05.
trajectory_endpoints.feedback_endpoint: For both fields, E_feedback,a=||a_full-a_one_way||_trajectory/max(||a_one_way||_trajectory,epsilon). One-way psi difference from eta=0 is expected to be exactly zero, so Phi and feedback endpoints are mandatory.

control_logic.target_requirement: For every null control and both target endpoints E_psi and E_Phi, the paired bootstrap 95% CI for mean(E_target-E_control) has lower endpoint >delta. The feedback endpoints must each have a 95% CI excluding zero and lower endpoint >delta.
control_logic.control_equivalence: For an intended no-feedback psi comparison, equivalence interval is [-delta,+delta]; declare practical equivalence only when its paired 95% CI lies wholly inside that interval. Failure to reject zero is not equivalence.
control_logic.label_permutation_caveat: If a valid complete cyclic pairing cannot be defined before execution, omit this control by creating a new protocol revision; do not improvise it after outcomes are visible.

convergence.restriction: Before every cross-grid comparison, restrict fine-grid Fourier fields to the common physical rectangular band |kx|,|ky|<=N_coarse/2-1, inverse transform, and compare on the coarse grid.
convergence.floor: For quantity q use error=||q_h-q_ref||/max(||q_ref||,1e-12); for signed scalar differences use denominator max(|q_ref|,1e-12).
required_quantities: full psi field over trajectory at common modes
full Phi field over trajectory at common modes
E_psi, E_Phi, and both feedback endpoints
free-energy trajectory sampled at fixed cadence
convergence.spatial: N=32,64,128; require 64-to-128 errors <=0.05 and 32-to-64 <=0.15 for each required quantity.
convergence.temporal: dt=0.0025,0.00125,0.000625 at N=128; require dt/2-to-dt/4 error <=0.02 and non-increasing refinement error above the 1e-12 floor.

energy_audit.D_num: Accumulate every accepted step by frozen left-point quadrature: sum_n dt_n [M_psi integral|grad mu_psi^n|^2 + M_Phi integral(mu_Phi^n)^2].
energy_audit.criteria: Report R_E at every dt; require median R_E<=1e-3, 95th percentile<=1e-2 across calibration seeds, and non-increasing R_E under dt refinement.
energy_audit.claim_limit: Residual convergence supports consistency with the continuous dissipation identity; it does not prove exact discrete monotonicity.

bootstrap.method: paired bootstrap over complete seed-level records
bootstrap.index_generator: Philox4x32-10 with seed 20260825; record an immutable manifest of all bootstrap indices and its SHA-256
bootstrap.ratio_rule: Recompute all ratio endpoints from resampled numerator/denominator records inside each replicate; never bootstrap precomputed ratios when the estimand is a ratio of ensemble means.
bootstrap.precision_limit: Sixteen held-out seeds may yield wide intervals. The count cannot increase after held-out outcomes are viewed; an inadequate interval is reported as inconclusive.

stages.definition: A condition is one seed x arm x grid x dt simulation. Counts exclude analytic calculations but include deterministic replay simulations.

A.purpose: analytic derivation, transform/startup audits, and calibration-only oracle

B.purpose: primary, eta=0, and three null controls at N=32/64 and dt=0.0025, calibration seeds

C.purpose: primary and eta=0 refinement at N=32/64/128 and three dt values, calibration seeds

D.purpose: eta=0.1 parameter sensitivity (lambda=0.5,2; v=0.5) plus sign-reversal at N=64, dt=0.00125, calibration seeds

E.purpose: held-out evaluation once: primary, eta=0, and three null controls at N=64, dt=0.00125; deterministic replays of all five arms for seeds 1001,1008,1016

reproducibility.same_environment: If deterministic reductions are promised, require bitwise-identical artifact hashes. Otherwise require numerical equivalence with explicit per-field relative L2 <=1e-10, scalar absolute <=1e-12 or relative <=1e-10, and identical status/seed/config hashes.
reproducibility.wording: Tolerance-based comparison is numerical equivalence, never exact identity.

hard_stops: post-start change to conditions, seeds, metrics, thresholds, or finalizer schema
eventual_claim_if_all_pass: Only for this frozen nondimensional classical mixed-flow surrogate, tested numerical domain, environment, and parameter arms: controlled coupling produced a finite, stable, convergent, reproducible, null-control-separated numerical difference.
